summary.text: Michele Rayner is a Democratic member of the Florida House of Representatives for District 62, first elected in 2020.

paragraphs.text: According to the House's biographical page, Rayner is an attorney and law firm owner who lives in St. Petersburg.
Rayner holds a B.S. in political science and an M.S. in international affairs from Florida State University and a J.D. from Florida Coastal School of Law.
